# Clearwater Resolution

The Clearwater Resolution is the board policy, adopted on March 19, 2026, under which the network no longer charges patrons for returning books, audiobooks, or magazines late. It is named for the Clearwater Grange hall, where the board met that evening while Main Street was under repair.

## What changed

- Daily late charges ended on April 1, 2026, at all five branches.
- Balances from past late returns were cleared from every account.
- Cards blocked only for late charges were unblocked.

## What did not change

Patrons still pay to replace items that are lost or damaged, and items unreturned for 45 days are billed as lost. Interlibrary loan items keep the lending library's rules.

## Owners

[[Ines Barrow]] coordinates the circulation side. The board's reasoning is in the [[Board meeting, 2026-03-19]] minutes.
